local FX = _G.FX
local CWelfarePreview = FX.Class("CWelfarePreview", "CWelfareUI")

-- 修改这里的配置即可增减条目或调整奖励；id 是稳定业务标识。
-- @param owner table 编辑器组件宿主
function CWelfarePreview:Ctor(owner)
    CWelfarePreview.Super.Ctor(self, owner)
    self.Config = {
        groups = {
            {
                kind = "online", page = "OnlineBox", columns = 3, gapX = 20, gapY = 16,
                items = {
                    {id = "online_5", minutes = 5, reward = "Coins ×100", icon = "Coin"},
                    {id = "online_10", minutes = 10, reward = "Coins ×200", icon = "Coin"},
                    {id = "online_15", minutes = 15, reward = "Diamonds ×20", icon = "Gem"},
                    {id = "online_30", minutes = 30, reward = "Coins ×500", icon = "Coin"},
                    {id = "online_45", minutes = 45, reward = "Diamonds ×50", icon = "Gem"},
                    {id = "online_60", minutes = 60, reward = "Common Egg ×1", icon = "Egg"}
                }
            },
            {
                kind = "signin", page = "SignInBox", columns = 3, gapX = 12, gapY = 16,
                items = {
                    {id = "day_1", day = 1, reward = "Coins ×100", icon = "Coin"},
                    {id = "day_2", day = 2, reward = "Coins ×200", icon = "Coin"},
                    {id = "day_3", day = 3, reward = "Common Egg ×1", icon = "Egg"},
                    {id = "day_4", day = 4, reward = "Diamonds ×50", icon = "Gem"},
                    {id = "day_5", day = 5, reward = "Coins ×500", icon = "Coin"},
                    {id = "day_6", day = 6, reward = "Diamonds ×100", icon = "Gem"},
                    {id = "day_7", day = 7, reward = "Rare Egg ×1", icon = "Egg", featured = true, badge = "Weekly Reward", color = {102, 80, 25}}
                }
            },
            {
                kind = "task", page = "TasksBox", columns = 1, gapX = 0, gapY = 12,
                items = {
                    {id = "collect_coins", title = "Collect 1,000 Coins", target = 1000, previewValue = 1000, reward = "Reward: Coins ×300"},
                    {id = "play_matches", title = "Play 3 Matches", target = 3, previewValue = 1, reward = "Reward: Diamonds ×30"},
                    {id = "hatch_egg", title = "Hatch 1 Pet Egg", target = 1, previewValue = 0, reward = "Reward: Coins ×500"}
                }
            }
        }
    }
    self.State = {
        tab = 1, closed = false, onlineMinutes = 12, onlineClaimed = {},
        signInDay = 1, signInClaimed = {},
        tasks = {}
    }
    for _, group in ipairs(self.Config.groups) do
        if group.kind == "task" then
            for _, item in ipairs(group.items) do
                self.State.tasks[item.id] = {value = item.previewValue or 0, claimed = false}
            end
        end
    end
end

-- 提供有序条目配置。
-- @return table 各页配置
function CWelfarePreview:GetUIConfig()
    return self.Config
end

-- 提供本地模拟状态。
-- @return table 展示数据
function CWelfarePreview:GetUIState()
    return self.State
end

-- 数据绑定后显示首帧。
function CWelfarePreview:BindUIData()
    self:RefreshUI()
end

-- 用稳定 ID 校验模拟领取；真实业务独立负责资格及发奖。
-- @param action string 动作名
-- @param payload table 页签或奖励业务 ID
function CWelfarePreview:OnUIAction(action, payload)
    local state = self.State
    if action == "SelectTab" then
        state.tab = payload.tabId
    elseif action == "Close" then
        state.closed = true
    elseif action == "Claim" then
        for _, group in ipairs(self.Config.groups) do
            if group.kind == payload.kind then
                for _, item in ipairs(group.items) do
                    if item.id == payload.rewardId then
                        if group.kind == "online" and state.onlineMinutes >= item.minutes then
                            state.onlineClaimed[item.id] = true
                        elseif group.kind == "signin" and item.day == state.signInDay then
                            state.signInClaimed[item.id] = true
                        elseif group.kind == "task" and state.tasks[item.id].value >= item.target then
                            state.tasks[item.id].claimed = true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    self:RefreshUI()
end

return CWelfarePreview

local FX = _G.FX
local Loader = FX.Loader
local CWelfareUI = FX.Class("CWelfareUI", "CUIEditorUICompClass")

-- 初始化页面与配置条目；每个克隆只绑定一次领取事件。
function CWelfareUI:OnReady()
    self.Root = Loader:PlayerGui("WelfareUI")
    self.Config = self:GetUIConfig()
    self.Rows = {}
    local tabs = {"OnlineTabBtn", "SignInTabBtn", "TasksTabBtn"}
    for index, name in ipairs(tabs) do
        self:TrackConnection(Loader:Here(self.Root, "TabsBox." .. name).Activated:Connect(function()
            self:EmitUIAction("SelectTab", {tabId = index})
        end))
    end
    for _, group in ipairs(self.Config.groups) do
        self:BuildItems(group)
    end
    self:TrackConnection(Loader:Here(self.Root, "TitleBox.CloseSurfaceImg.CloseBtn").Activated:Connect(function()
        self:EmitUIAction("Close", {})
    end))
end

-- 从可编辑模板克隆配置项，并按模板尺寸排列。
-- @param group table 页面、列数、间距和有序条目配置
function CWelfareUI:BuildItems(group)
    local page = Loader:Here(self.Root, "PopupPanelImg." .. group.page)
    local template = Loader:Here(page, "ItemTemplateImg")
    local container = Loader:Here(page, "ItemsBox")
    template.Visible = false
    for _, old in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
        old:Destroy()
    end
    local width = template.Size.X.Offset
    local height = template.Size.Y.Offset
    local normalIndex = 0
    local bottom = 0
    self.Rows[group.kind] = {}
    for index, config in ipairs(group.items) do
        local row = template:Clone()
        row.Name = "Item_" .. config.id .. "Img"
        row.Parent = container
        row.Visible = true
        row.LayoutOrder = index
        local x = (normalIndex % group.columns) * (width + group.gapX)
        local y = math.floor(normalIndex / group.columns) * (height + group.gapY)
        if config.featured then
            x = group.columns * (width + group.gapX)
            y = 0
            row.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height * 2 + group.gapY)
            self:StyleFeatured(row, config)
        else
            normalIndex = normalIndex + 1
        end
        row.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + 2, y + 2)
        bottom = math.max(bottom, y + row.Size.Y.Offset)
        Loader:Here(row, "RewardTxt").Text = config.reward
        if group.kind == "task" then
            Loader:Here(row, "TaskNameTxt").Text = config.title
        else
            Loader:Here(row, group.kind == "online" and "TimeTxt" or "DayTxt").Text = group.kind == "online" and (config.minutes .. " min") or ("Day " .. config.day)
            for _, icon in ipairs({"Coin", "Gem", "Egg"}) do
                Loader:Here(row, icon .. "IconBox").Visible = config.icon == icon
            end
        end
        local button = Loader:Here(row, "ClaimBtn")
        self:TrackConnection(button.Activated:Connect(function()
            self:EmitUIAction("Claim", {kind = group.kind, rewardId = config.id})
        end))
        self.Rows[group.kind][config.id] = row
    end
    container.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(792, bottom + 4)
end

-- 将同一签到模板排成双行高度大奖；颜色与标签由配置提供。
-- @param row Instance 克隆出来的签到条目
-- @param config table 大奖显示配置
function CWelfareUI:StyleFeatured(row, config)
    row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(config.color[1], config.color[2], config.color[3])
    local label = Loader:Here(row, "WeeklyTxt")
    label.Visible = true
    label.Text = config.badge
    local width = row.Size.X.Offset
    for _, type in ipairs({"Coin", "Gem", "Egg"}) do
        local box = Loader:Here(row, type .. "IconBox")
        local icon = Loader:Here(box, "RewardIconImg")
        icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((width - 64) / 2, 92)
        icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64)
        for _, child in ipairs(box:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name == "IconMarkTxt" then
                child.Position = icon.Position
                child.Size = icon.Size
            end
        end
    end
    local reward = Loader:Here(row, "RewardTxt")
    reward.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 176)
    reward.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 55)
    local button = Loader:Here(row, "ClaimBtn")
    button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(button.Position.X.Offset, row.Size.Y.Offset - 48)
end

-- 更新按钮文案与可用状态，保留模板的完整表面。
-- @param button Instance 实际点击按钮
-- @param label string 英文状态文字
-- @param enabled boolean 是否允许领取
function CWelfareUI:RenderButton(button, label, enabled)
    self:SetButtonEnabled(button, enabled)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(103, 237, 20) or Color3.fromRGB(99, 128, 121)
    Loader:Here(button, "ButtonTxt").Text = label
    Loader:Here(button, "BottomEdgeImg").BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(34, 90, 7) or Color3.fromRGB(38, 62, 54)
end

-- 只更新克隆条目的状态，不在每次刷新时重新克隆。
-- @param state table 在线时长、签到与按业务 ID 保存的任务状态
function CWelfareUI:Render(state)
    self.Root.Enabled = not state.closed
    local tabs = {"OnlineTabBtn", "SignInTabBtn", "TasksTabBtn"}
    local labels = {"Online\nRewards", "Daily Login", "Tasks"}
    for index, group in ipairs(self.Config.groups) do
        Loader:Here(self.Root, "PopupPanelImg." .. group.page).Visible = state.tab == index
        local button = Loader:Here(self.Root, "TabsBox." .. tabs[index])
        self:RenderButton(button, labels[index], true)
        if state.tab ~= index then
            button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(99, 128, 121)
            Loader:Here(button, "BottomEdgeImg").BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 62, 54)
        end
        for _, config in ipairs(group.items) do
            local row = self.Rows[group.kind][config.id]
            local enabled = false
            local label = "Locked"
            if group.kind == "online" then
                local claimed = state.onlineClaimed[config.id]
                enabled = state.onlineMinutes >= config.minutes and not claimed
                label = claimed and "Claimed" or (enabled and "Claim" or "Locked")
            elseif group.kind == "signin" then
                local claimed = state.signInClaimed[config.id]
                enabled = config.day == state.signInDay and not claimed
                label = claimed and "Checked In" or (enabled and "Check In" or (config.day == state.signInDay + 1 and "Tomorrow" or "Locked"))
            else
                local item = state.tasks[config.id]
                local bar = Loader:Here(row, "ProgressBarImg")
                Loader:Here(bar, "ProgressFillImg").Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.min(item.value / config.target, 1), 1)
                Loader:Here(bar, "ProgressTxt").Text = item.value .. " / " .. config.target
                enabled = item.value >= config.target and not item.claimed
                label = item.claimed and "Claimed" or (enabled and "Claim" or "In Progress")
            end
            self:RenderButton(Loader:Here(row, "ClaimBtn"), label, enabled)
        end
    end
    Loader:Here(self.Root, "PopupPanelImg.OnlineBox.SubtitleTxt").Text = "Online: " .. state.onlineMinutes .. " min · Resets daily"
    Loader:Here(self.Root, "PopupPanelImg.SignInBox.HeadingTxt").Text = "Daily Login · Day " .. state.signInDay
end

return CWelfareUI
